instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: SynergyCloud is a medium-sized B2B SaaS provider specializing in workflow automation tools for mid-market enterprises. The company focuses on improving operational efficiency through scalable cloud software solutions.
answers.pastInitiatives: The company has successfully piloted three major platform upgrades focusing on enhancing data security and integrating new AI modules into their core product suite over the last two years.
answers.strategicGoals: Our primary goal is to maintain market share by differentiating our existing product offerings through continuous feature improvements. We aim to secure key enterprise contracts in emerging vertical markets.
answers.teamSize: The core innovation team consists of 5 software engineers and 2 product managers, operating under a close small leadership team structure.
answers.additionalContext: Despite strong retention, we are facing increased pressure from larger competitors who offer more integrated solutions.

opportunities.title: AI-Driven Predictive Maintenance Module
opportunities.rationale: Implementing an incremental AI module into the existing platform can significantly enhance customer retention and product stickiness by offering proactive solutions.

first_actions: Select a suitable ML model for predicting system failures within Q3.
Allocate dedicated resources from the engineering team to build an MVP.
execution_plan.success_metric: 15% reduction in customer churn rate within 6 months.
milestones: Model training completed by end of Q3.
Beta launch with top 2 pilot clients in Q4.

opportunities.title: Vertical-Specific Hyper-Automation Platform
opportunities.rationale: A radical approach involves developing a completely new, highly specialized automation platform targeting a specific high-growth vertical (e.g., FinTech compliance) that current offerings do not address.

first_actions: Conduct deep market analysis for the 'FinTech Compliance' niche.
Form a dedicated cross-functional task force.
execution_plan.success_metric: Capture 5 paying customers in the targeted vertical within 18 months.
milestones: Launch of V1 specialized platform by end of Year 2.

opportunities.title: Customer Success Automation Overhaul
opportunities.rationale: Streamlining the customer onboarding and support lifecycle using advanced AI chatbots and personalized workflow routing can reduce operational costs while improving service quality.

first_actions: Evaluate current CRM/Support tools for integration capabilities.
execution_plan.success_metric: 30% reduction in average customer support response time (MTTR).
milestones: Internal pilot deployment complete within 4 months.
Full rollout across all tiers by end of year.

next_steps.action: Finalize the business case and resource allocation for the AI Predictive Maintenance Module.
Initiate market research phase for the 'Vertical-Specific Hyper-Automation Platform' radical opportunity.
Conduct a full audit of current customer success processes to identify immediate efficiency gains (incremental).

key_weaknesses: Over-reliance on legacy technical debt in core infrastructure.
Talent bottleneck for specialized AI/ML skills.
Slow internal process for radical product ideation and execution.
